--- ## Simple on the Surface. Rocket Engine Underneath. Most timeline tools force an unfair trade-off: spreadsheets break the moment one date slips, commercial Gantt suites lock basic features behind \$15–\$49/user/month paywalls, and asking ChatGPT to code an HTML/Mermaid chart gives you a static, broken picture you cannot drag or update. **Jantt removes every barrier at once:** | Promise | What It Means for You | | :--- | :--- | | **No Code Needed** | Drag bars visually, resize deadlines, connect arrows, or describe your plan in plain English to the built-in AI Copilot. You never have to write a single line of code or JSON unless you want to. | | **Free Forever + Free Cloud Rooms** | 100% MIT open source. Use offline in your browser with **zero sign-up**, or sign in free with GitHub for **real-time multi-user cloud rooms**, shareable links, and unlimited exports. | | **100% Client-Side Privacy** | Your local schedules stay in your browser. BYOK AI calls go directly from your browser to your provider (or run **100% offline and free with Ollama**). Zero lock-in: every plan is clean, portable JSON you own. | | **Grows With Your Ambition** | Start with a 5-task study checklist today; unlock working-calendar Critical Path analysis, Earned Value Management (EVM), Monte Carlo risk simulation, 60 FPS Canvas, and MS Project / Primavera P6 interop whenever you need them. | --- ## Create and Edit Gantt Charts with AI (Built-In Copilot) Stop wrestling with spreadsheet rows or begging chatbots for fragile SVG/React code. Jantt ships a **built-in AI Copilot** directly inside the live workspace: just open the Copilot drawer and describe what you want in plain English. ### How It Works in 3 Steps 1. **Describe or Paste Anything in Plain English:** Type a goal, paste messy meeting notes, or ask to push deadlines, flag urgent risks, rebalance workloads, or add milestones. 2. **Review the Visual Diff Preview:** Jantt validates the AI's structured output against its strict schema and displays an exact **added / updated / removed diff preview** before touching your schedule. Zero surprise overwrites. 3. **Apply in One Click:** Accept the change with full **Undo / Redo** support. Dependencies automatically cascade, working days recalculate, and all 6 views update immediately. ### Bring Your Own Key (10 Providers) or Run 100% Free & Local Your API keys stay strictly in your browser's `localStorage` and connect directly to your provider: never through a Jantt proxy. **Live dynamic model discovery** (`/models` and Ollama `/api/tags`) automatically fetches the latest models from your account with instant search and context-window tags. | Provider Category | Supported Providers | | :--- | :--- | | **Generous Free Tiers** | **Google Gemini** (Google AI Studio), **Groq**, **OpenRouter** | | **Frontier Cloud Models** | **OpenAI**, **Anthropic Claude**, **DeepSeek**, **Mistral**, **xAI Grok** | | **100% Free & Offline Local** | **Ollama** (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma running privately on your own machine) | | **Custom Endpoints** | Any **OpenAI-compatible** gateway, corporate endpoint, or local server (LM Studio, vLLM) | ### Try Prompts Like These Right Now - **Student Thesis & Exams:** *"Build a 12-week Master's thesis timeline from literature review to final defense, Monday through Friday only, with advisor review milestones and exam prep buffer."* - **Personal Life & Moving:** *"Organize a 6-week apartment move with packing rooms, utility transfers, lease handoff, and a budget under \$2,500."* - **Team Meeting to Action Plan:** *"Turn these meeting notes into a 4-week product launch Gantt chart with owners, dependencies, and urgent blockers highlighted."* - **Live Schedule Surgery:** *"Push the QA phase back by 5 working days, mark the security audit urgent, and tell me what just became the bottleneck."* --- ## Built for Everyone: Real-World Use Cases Jantt is not just for Fortune 500 schedulers or software engineers. Open [the live app](https://ahmadhassan-bted.github.io/Jantt/) and start organizing whatever matters to you right now: ### Organizing for Students, PhD/MS Applicants & Researchers - **University & Planning:** Map coursework, lab experiments, advisor sign-off milestones, and revision weeks, then flip to **Checklist View** each morning to tick off today's work with one click. - **Zero Cost for Collaboration and Zero-Lock-In Privacy Use Jantt completely offline with zero account, or collaborate live with teammates for free: - **Instant Local Mode (Zero Account):** Open the web app and start building immediately. Every edit auto-saves locally in your browser, and every view remembers your scroll, zoom, and filters. - **Free Real-Time Cloud Rooms:** Sign in with **GitHub OAuth** (minimal `read:user` scope: no passwords, no Google tracking) to claim your `@username`, create live shared cloud rooms, invite collaborators with **Owner**, **Editor**, or **Viewer** roles, and merge concurrent edits safely via ACID transactions and a 3-way CRDT reconciler. - **Compressed Share Links:** Share any plan as a self-contained, `fflate`-compressed URL snapshot: zero server required for read-only viewing. - **Zero Database ID Leakage:** `sanitizePlanForJson` recursively strips private UIDs, secrets, and room tokens before any write or export. Technical Details: Firebase RTDB Security Rules & Architecture - **GitHub-Only Auth:** Restricted to GitHub OAuth 2.0 (`read:user` scope). Automatically registers your verified GitHub handle into `/usernames/{username}` on first sign-in. - **Security Rules (`database.rules.json`):** - `/users`: Indexed on `username` (`.indexOn: ["username"]`) for live prefix search; users may only write their own record. - `/usernames`: Atomic handle registration preventing username collisions. - `/user_rooms`: Fast dashboard listing of owned and shared cloud rooms. - `/rooms`: ACID transactions via `runTransaction` with 3-way CRDT reconciliation; only owners and editors can mutate plan state. - **Optional Verification Gate:** `ENABLE_GITHUB_VERIFICATION_GATE` in `apps/playground/src/firebase/githubVerificationService.ts` (off by default) supports optional public follower/star checks using no additional OAuth scopes.
--- ## Enterprise Scheduling Engine Under the Hood Every calculation is written in strict TypeScript, verified by **1,290+ automated unit and integration tests** plus Python bridge tests: | Algorithmic Engine | Standard / Math | What It Does | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Topological DAG Cascade** | $O(V + E)$ Tarjan SCC + topological sort | Cascades FS/SS/FF/SF links with lags/leads; respects `locked: true` milestones and isolates cycles safely without crashing. | | **Working-Calendar CPM** | 2-pass AON + mixed-calendar longest-path | Computes ES, EF, LS, LF, Total Float, and Free Float on each task's resolved calendar (task -> person -> project -> Mon–Fri), honoring regional holidays (`US`, `UK`/`GB`, `EU`, `CA`, `AU`) and custom shifts without splitting mixed-calendar critical paths. | | **Resource Leveling** | Priority- & float-aware capacity solver | Detects resource over-allocations per person/capacity and previews conflict-free schedule shifts before you apply them. | | **Earned Value (EVM)** | ANSI/EIA-748 (`PV`, `EV`, `AC`, `CPI`, `SPI`, `EAC`, `TCPI`) | Tracks cost and schedule variance across your budget with honest forecasting. | | **DCMA-14 Schedule Audit** | Selected DCMA 14-point checks (`A`–`F` grade) | Flags missing logic, leads, lags, non-FS links, hard constraints, high float (>44 working days), negative float, high duration, out-of-sequence progress, and broken links. | | **PERT & Monte Carlo Risk** | $\mu = \frac{O + 4M + P}{6}$, 5,000+ stochastic runs | Computes probabilistic completion dates (P50 / P80 / P90), on-time deadline confidence, and task criticality index off the main thread in a Web Worker. | --- ## Developer and AI Agent Quickstarts Embed Jantt into any web app, notebook, CLI pipeline, or AI agent in under 60 seconds: ### 1. Show code snippets for Headless Core, MS Project / Primavera Interop, 60 FPS Canvas & Yjs Multiplayer #### Headless Core Engine (`@jantt/core`) ```ts import { resolveSchedule, calculateCriticalPath, validate, exportToCsv } from "@jantt/core"; const validation = validate(rawJson); if (!validation.valid) console.error("Schema errors:", validation.errors); const options = { defaultGapDays: rawJson.meta?.defaultGapDays ?? 2, calendar: rawJson.meta?.calendar, useWorkingDays: rawJson.meta?.useWorkingDays, calendars: rawJson.calendars, people: rawJson.people }; const resolvedTasks = resolveSchedule(rawJson.tasks, options); const { criticalTaskIds, projectTotalFloat } = calculateCriticalPath(resolvedTasks, { ...options, targetDate: rawJson.meta?.targetDate }); const csvData = exportToCsv({ ...rawJson, tasks: resolvedTasks }); ``` #### Enterprise MS Project, Primavera P6 & Executive Report Interop (`@jantt/interop`) ```ts import { exportMsProjectXml, importMsProjectXml, exportPrimaveraXer, importPrimaveraXer, exportExecutiveReportHtml } from "@jantt/interop"; const msXml = exportMsProjectXml(plan); const p6Xer = exportPrimaveraXer(plan); const reportHtml = exportExecutiveReportHtml(plan.tasks, { title: plan.meta?.title ?? "Executive Status Report", theme: "corporate", defaultGapDays: plan.meta?.defaultGapDays, targetDate: plan.meta?.targetDate, calendar: plan.meta?.calendar, useWorkingDays: plan.meta?.useWorkingDays, calendars: plan.calendars, people: plan.people }); const importedPlan = importMsProjectXml(msXml); ``` #### High-Performance 60 FPS Canvas Engine (`@jantt/render-canvas`) ```ts import { CanvasTimelineRenderer } from "@jantt/render-canvas"; const renderer = new CanvasTimelineRenderer(hugePlan, { dayWidth: 36, rowHeight: 34, showCriticalPath: true }); renderer.render(ctx, { scrollX, scrollY, width, height }); ``` #### Real-Time Multiplayer CRDT (`@jantt/yjs`) ```ts import * as Y from "yjs"; import { bindJanttToYDoc, createJanttUndoManager } from "@jantt/yjs"; const doc = new Y.Doc(); const binding = bindJanttToYDoc(doc, { initialPlan, onPlanChange: (plan) => render(plan) }); binding.updateTask("t1", { progress: 0.85 }); const undoManager = createJanttUndoManager(doc); undoManager.undo(); ```

Copy-Paste LLM System Prompt & Full Schema Cheatsheet ```text You are a precision project management schedule generator. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON conforming strictly to the Jantt JSON Schema (https://ahmadhassan-bted.github.io/Jantt/schema/v1.json). # JANTT JSON SCHEMA SPECIFICATION CHEATSHEET ## 1. Top-Level Root Structure { "$schema": "https://ahmadhassan-bted.github.io/Jantt/schema/v1.json", "meta": { "title": "", "description": "", "person": "", "organization": "", "start": "YYYY-MM-DD", "end": "YYYY-MM-DD", "targetDate": "YYYY-MM-DD", "calendar": "standard", "useWorkingDays": true, "defaultGapDays": 2, "scale": "day" | "week" | "month" | "quarter" | "year", "linkRouting": "orthogonal" | "curved" | "direct", "showCriticalPath": false, "showBaselines": false, "autoCascade": true, "currency": "USD", "budget": 450000 }, "categories": { "": { "label": "", "color": "#HEX_COLOR", "soft": "#BG_TINT_HEX", "icon": "" } }, "calendars": { "site": { "workingDays": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], "region": "US", "holidays": ["2026-11-09"] } }, "people": [ { "id": "@alex", "name": "Alex Mercer", "username": "@alex", "role": "Lead Architect", "teamId": "core-team", "color": "#3B82F6" } ], "teams": [ { "id": "core-team", "name": "Core Platform Squad", "color": "#3B82F6" } ], "notes": [ { "id": "note-1", "title": "Kickoff Notes", "content": "Markdown notes with @alex and task links.", "pinned": true, "task_ids": ["t1"] } ], "tasks": [ { "id": "t1", "wbs": "1.1", "label": "Task Title", "category": "", "start": "YYYY-MM-DD", "end": "YYYY-MM-DD", "assignee": "@alex", "priority": "low" | "medium" | "high" | "urgent", "estimatedCost": 12000, "actualCost": 5000, "dependsOn": "prereq-id" | ["prereq-1:FS+2d", "prereq-2:SS"] | null, "gapDays": 2, "locked": false, "progress": 0.5, "milestone": false, "status": "not-started" | "in-progress" | "submitted" | "completed" | "blocked", "urgent": false, "baseline": { "start": "YYYY-MM-DD", "end": "YYYY-MM-DD" }, "notes": "Acceptance criteria and details.", "fields": { "deliverable": "v1" } } ] } ## 2. Validation Rules 1. DATES: ISO "YYYY-MM-DD" format; "end" must be >= "start". 2. CATEGORIES: Every task "category" must match a key in "categories". 3. DEPENDENCIES (DAG): Valid task IDs only; no circular loops; supports FS/SS/FF/SF with lag/lead shorthand (e.g. "t1:FS+2d", "t1:SS-1d"). 4. MILESTONES: Set "milestone": true and "start" === "end". 5. PROGRESS: Decimal float from 0.0 to 1.0. 6. NO DATABASE IDS: Never include internal UIDs, tokens, or secrets; use canonical "@username" handles for real accounts. ```
